name: LinkedIn

verdict.headline: Sign In with LinkedIn and Share on LinkedIn are self-serve and granted instantly, but Community Management needs a legal entity, a verified business email, a dedicated app and vetting with no stated review time.
verdict.nextAction: Create or confirm your organization's LinkedIn Page, then create the app; if you need Community Management, request it on a new app that has no other products.

appType: Use a dedicated app for Community Management: it must be the only product on that app. Self-serve products (Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect, Share on LinkedIn) can go on a separate app.

paths.name: Sign In with LinkedIn / Share (self-serve)
paths.whenThisApplies: You only need member sign-in (openid profile email) or posting as the member (w_member_social). Events Management is described as self-serve on request.

timeline.label: Create the app and configure redirect URLs
Confirm or create a LinkedIn Page
timeline.note: Under 1 hour if a Page has to be created (our estimate).

timeline.label: Add the product in the Products tab
timeline.note: Minutes. Self-serve products are granted instantly with no provider review. Each user still gives per-user consent.

paths.name: Community Management / Marketing APIs (vetted access)
paths.whenThisApplies: You need to post or read as an organization, or use Advertising, Community Management, Lead Sync or Conversions. These are open to any vetted legal entity.

timeline.label: Create a dedicated app and request the product
Legal entity, business email, website and privacy policy
timeline.note: Days to weeks if any of these are missing (our estimate).

timeline.label: Page super admin verifies the app
timeline.note: The super admin has 30 days to approve the verification request. What happens when the window expires is not documented.

timeline.label: Complete the vetting survey
timeline.note: The survey must be completed within 21 days, and the business email must be verified.

timeline.label: Development tier review (Access Form Review, Identity Vetting, App Review)
timeline.note: No review time is published. Restricted APIs have "no fixed timeline" (stated).

timeline.label: Rejection: create a new app and start again
timeline.note: A rejected app cannot re-apply. The exception is "Insufficient Details", which enables a Reapply button on the same app.

timeline.label: Standard tier upgrade review (required later)
timeline.note: A second required review after Development tier. You must reach Standard within 12 months of approval or LinkedIn removes access for inactivity.

timeline.label: Ads Standard tier review (Advertising API only)
timeline.note: Up to 30 business days. Requests for analytics-only use cases are rejected.

timeline.label: Each customer's Page admin authorizes through OAuth
timeline.note: End-user customers need the ADMINISTRATOR Page role, which can only be granted in the LinkedIn UI.

beforeApproval.item: Community Management starts on Development tier once approved
beforeApproval.detail: 500 calls per app per 24 h, 100 calls per member per 24 h, no BATCH_GET, social-action webhooks disabled. Standard tier has no restrictions.
Otherwise LinkedIn removes access for inactivity.
Unlimited reads, 1 test ad account created through the API, and edits on up to 5 ad accounts, which you map in the Products tab.

beforeApproval.item: Self-serve apps get no refresh token
beforeApproval.detail: Access tokens last 60 days; users must re-run OAuth. Consent is skipped if the user is still logged in and the token is still valid.

prerequisites.item: A LinkedIn Page for your organization
prerequisites.detail: You must select a default Page when creating the app, even as an individual developer. The app is permanently tied to that Page and cannot be moved.

prerequisites.item: Page super admin verification (vetted Marketing products)
prerequisites.detail: Documented as required for vetted products such as Community Management. Not documented as required for self-serve products.

prerequisites.item: Registered legal organization with a commercial use case (Community Management)
prerequisites.detail: Without a legal entity, only self-serve products are available.

prerequisites.item: Legal name, registered address, website and privacy policy (Community Management)
Community Management must be the app's only product
prerequisites.detail: The request button is greyed out if the app has any other product or pending request.

prerequisites.item: App name with no "LinkedIn" or "Microsoft" fragments
prerequisites.detail: Fragments such as "Linked" or "In" are not allowed.
No "#" allowed; query parameters are ignored.

prerequisites.item: Partner-only and closed products are not available through the standard request flow
prerequisites.detail: Sales Navigator (SNAP), Talent (RSC, Apply Connect and others), Audience Insights, Media Planning and Matched Audiences are partner or restricted; apply through the business.linkedin.com partner forms. Compliance, Company Intelligence, r_full_profile and r_member_social are closed.

steps.title: Create or confirm the LinkedIn Page
steps.detail: The app will be permanently tied to this Page.

steps.title: Create the app in the Developer Portal and select the Page
steps.detail: Use an app name with no "LinkedIn" or "Microsoft" fragments.
steps.agentHelp: An agent can check the proposed app name for disallowed fragments.

steps.title: Page super admin approves the verification request
steps.detail: The super admin has 30 days. If they don't respond, get the admin role or chase them.

steps.title: Configure redirect URLs and record the Client ID and Secret
steps.detail: Redirect URLs must be HTTPS and absolute, with no "#"; query parameters are ignored.

steps.title: Add or request products in the Products tab
steps.detail: Self-serve: add Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect or Share on LinkedIn, granted instantly. Community Management: request it on a dedicated app that has no other products.

steps.title: Complete the vetting survey and verify the business email
steps.detail: The survey must be completed within 21 days. Check the spam and promotions folders for the verification email.
steps.agentHelp: An agent can draft the use-case answers and check them against the restricted-use-cases list.

steps.title: LinkedIn reviews the request
steps.detail: Access Form Review, then Identity Vetting, then App Review. No review time is stated.

steps.title: Build against Development tier limits with 3-legged OAuth
steps.detail: Implement the authorization code flow with state checking. The auth code expires after 30 minutes. Stay within 500 calls per app and 100 calls per member per 24 h.

steps.title: Submit the Standard tier request
steps.detail: Include a company and product overview, use cases, test credentials, and a narrated, downloadable, high-resolution screencast per use case.
steps.agentHelp: An agent can draft the company and product overview, the use-case descriptions and a screencast script per use case.

steps.title: LinkedIn reviews the Standard tier request
steps.detail: No SLA is stated. Must be reached within 12 months of Development tier approval.

steps.title: Each customer's Page admin authorizes through OAuth
steps.detail: Customers need the ADMINISTRATOR Page role. Page roles can only be granted in the LinkedIn UI, not through the API.

submissionChecklist.item: Page verified by a super admin

submissionChecklist.detail: Check the spam and promotions folders for the verification email.

submissionChecklist.item: Legal entity details, website and domain match the Page's organization
Use case checked against the restricted-use-cases list
submissionChecklist.detail: For example, displaying a Page feed off LinkedIn is not approved.
No "LinkedIn" or "Microsoft" fragments such as "Linked" or "In".

submissionChecklist.item: Standard tier only: screencast per use case
submissionChecklist.detail: Narrated, downloadable, high resolution. Show the full OAuth flow, posting, how comments and commenter profile fields are displayed, and analytics.

gotchas.title: A rejection means building a new app
gotchas.detail: You cannot re-apply with a rejected app; fix the issue and create a new app, or file a vetting appeal. The exception is "Insufficient Details" (survey not submitted within 21 days), which enables a Reapply button on the same app.

gotchas.title: Community Management must be the app's only product
gotchas.detail: The request button is greyed out if the app has any other product or pending request.

gotchas.title: Access is removed if Standard tier isn't reached within 12 months
gotchas.detail: Development tier is a starting point, not a permanent state. The Standard tier upgrade is a second required review with no stated SLA.

gotchas.title: The app is permanently tied to its Page
gotchas.detail: The Page link cannot be moved after app creation.

gotchas.title: Token lifetimes
gotchas.detail: Access tokens last 60 days. Programmatic refresh tokens last 365 days with a fixed TTL and are only for approved MDP partners. Self-serve apps get no refresh token and must re-run OAuth.

gotchas.title: Changing scopes invalidates every prior access token
gotchas.detail: All users are forced to re-authenticate.

gotchas.title: Users can't pick scopes
gotchas.detail: They must accept all requested scopes or none.

gotchas.title: Share on LinkedIn rate limits and member-only posting
gotchas.detail: 150 requests per member per day and 100,000 per app per day. It posts as the member only; posting as an organization needs Community Management.

gotchas.title: OIDC does not verify identity
gotchas.detail: The email field may be absent from the response.

gotchas.title: Ads Standard requests for analytics-only use cases are rejected
gotchas.detail: Ads Standard review takes up to 30 business days.

gotchas.title: Partner-only and closed products
gotchas.detail: Sales Navigator, Talent and Audience Insights are partner or restricted (apply through business.linkedin.com partner forms; difficulty 5/5). Compliance, Company Intelligence, r_full_profile and r_member_social are closed.

gotchas.title: Marketing API version 202511 sunsets on 2026-11-16
gotchas.detail: Integrations on that version need to move before the sunset date.

blockers.symptom: No legal entity or business email
blockers.whatToDo: Use self-serve products only; Community Management is unavailable.
Get the admin role or chase the super admin; the request lapses after 30 days.

blockers.symptom: Denied, for example "Fail Organization Verification" or "Invalid Company Page"
blockers.whatToDo: File a vetting appeal through the dsapi form, or fix the issue and create a new app.
Use the Reapply button on the same app.
Finish the integration, then apply for Standard tier.
Apply through the business.linkedin.com partner forms.

channels.label: Developer Support Portal
channels.note: Form types: Developer Support and Vetting Appeal. No support response SLA is stated.

unknowns: Typical review durations for Development or Standard tier; none are published.
Whether Page verification is enforced for self-serve products.
Whether self-serve apps can request refresh tokens at all.
Matched Audiences status: the Increasing Access page says "apply", but the FAQ says it uses a private interest form with LinkedIn replying within 60 days only if there is a fit.
What happens when the 30-day super-admin window expires.
No support response SLA is stated.
Setup and prerequisite durations are our estimates, not provider figures.
A third-party writeup says approval times "vary widely"; not confirmed by LinkedIn.
